recipes.title: Theme-respecting table

provenance.note: Independently written from documented Openplanet UI APIs; no palette or external source copied.

recipes.expected: A two-column table inherits active theme colors and spacing; changing Openplanet themes changes its chrome.

recipes.title: Balanced NVG scissor

provenance.note: Tiny independent API exercise; deliberately not copied from any plugin helper family.

recipes.expected: A cyan circle is clipped to a fixed rectangle and a white outline reveals the expected clip boundary.

recipes.title: Clipped draw-list gradient

provenance.note: Independently written API demonstration using a generated four-corner gradient.

recipes.expected: A fixed-size four-corner gradient stays inside its clip rectangle; clip depth returns to zero.

recipes.title: Deterministic pulse state

provenance.note: Independent minimal state model; capture phase is controlled by gallery frame, not wall-clock time.

recipes.expected: The progress bar and reported phase exactly match capture frames 0, 30, 60, 90, and 120.
